stages.reference: Create a close visual reference for ancient cobblestone slowly colonized by moss in a damp grounded dark-fantasy environment. The underlying stones remain distinct, worn and mineral-rich, while moss occupies protected joints, pits and persistently moist faces according to believable growth conditions. Some areas are velvety and dark green; others expose dry stone, old dirt and dead brown-green growth. Avoid covering every stone uniformly, bright emerald carpet, decorative vines or simply tinting cobble green. The material should tell a long relationship between masonry, moisture and living growth, with stone still dominant enough to read as cobblestone.
